name: Cable Lying Fly
steps: Center a flat bench between two low pulleys and lie face up with your feet flat.
Hold both handles above your chest with palms facing each other and a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms in wide arcs until your upper arms are level with your torso.
Sweep both handles back together above your chest, squeezing your pecs briefly at the top.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades against the bench as you open your arms.
Keep a fixed elbow angle throughout instead of bending your arms into a press.
